episodeTitle.en: How we restructured Airtable's entire org for AI | Howie Liu (co-founder and CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 我们如何为AI重组Airtable的整个组织 | 豪伊·刘（联合创始人兼CEO）

guestBioOfficial.en: Howie Liu is the co-founder and CEO of Airtable, the no-code platform valued at around $12 billion. After a viral tweet declared “Airtable is dead” based on incorrect data, Howie led a radical transformation: reorganizing the entire company around AI, becoming an “IC CEO” who codes daily, and achieving over $100 million in free cash flow. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 豪伊·刘是Airtable的联合创始人兼CEO，这家无代码平台估值约120亿美元。在一次基于错误数据的"Airtable已死"病毒式推文后，豪伊领导了一场彻底变革：围绕AI重组整个公司，转变为每天编码的"IC CEO"，并实现了超过1亿美元的自由现金流。*你将学习到：*

title.en: How we restructured Airtable's entire org for AI | Howie Liu (co-founder and CEO)
title.zh: 我们如何为AI重组Airtable的整个组织 | 豪伊·刘（联合创始人兼CEO）

summary.en: Howie exemplifies the 'IC CEO' trend—founders diving back into building themselves—and shares the specific skills he believes PMs, engineers, and designers need now (e.g., PMs becoming hybrid prototypers with design sensibility). He explains how he restructured Airtable into a 'fast-thinking' and a 'slow-thinking' group to accelerate AI investment, and how he encourages his team to cancel meetings and just experiment with AI tools. The episode is a practical playbook for navigating the existential AI transition every company is facing.
summary.zh: Howie 是“IC CEO”（创始人重新下场做具体工作）趋势的代表——他分享了认为 PM、工程师和设计师当下需要的具体技能（例如 PM 要变成兼具设计感的混合原型师）。他解释了如何把 Airtable 重组成“快思考”和“慢思考”两个组以加速 AI 投入，以及他如何鼓励团队取消会议、去亲手试用 AI 工具。这期节目是应对每家公司都在经历的 AI 生存转型的实用手册。
